status: Migrated from isolated staging after component verification; root owns host integration and integrated test results
scope: Per-repository setup settings only. No usage journal, cleanup prompt or metadata watcher implementation in this slice.

native_components.WorktreeSettingsController: QObject borrowing the existing GitService, owned by the host beyond any rebuilt Settings pane; owns separate repository/variant drafts, request IDs, revision handling and guarded mutation lifecycle.
native_components.WorktreeSettingsPane: Native QWidget view with repository and Shell/PowerShell selection, actual script paths, source templates, Save/Reset/Ctrl+S, Codex fallback notice, copyable environment variables, managed-worktree search and confirmed Settings-policy removal.
native_components.GitService: Shared per-common-directory serialization; setup writes accept a currently trusted anchor and derive/revalidate its main root. Caller does not grant arbitrary main-path trust.
native_components.SetupScriptText: Bounded strict UTF-8 decoder/encoder independent of QtWidgets; preserves BOM and reconciles existing delimiters outside the changed range, reusing prior delimiters within the replaced range. Unsupported bytes remain untouched.

integration_contract.ownership: Root owns WorktreeSettingsController(sharedGitService, parent). Construct/recreate WorktreeSettingsPane(controller, parent) as needed. Destroy controller before GitPanel/shared service during host shutdown.
integration_contract.guard: Set controller.setMutationGuard using the same host busy-agent/setup/terminal/editor policy as GitPanel. No guard means mutation controls remain disabled. SaveSetupScript guard targets main root and should close only related setup-script editors.
integration_contract.removal: Retain existing shared GitService worktreeRemoved forwarding as the single successful-removal notification. Settings cannot force removal and backend rechecks mounted/dirty/main/detached/managed policy.
integration_contract.close: Host blocks close during controller mutation and asks Discard/Cancel for unsaved drafts. View destruction alone preserves drafts and operation completion because the controller survives.
integration_contract.theme: Call pane.setDarkTheme(bool); pane CodeEditor object name is worktreeSetupEditor.
integration_contract.build: Nested ade_git and ade_git_ui CMake targets include the new files. New test_worktree_settings links ade_git_ui and Qt6::Test and imports QOffscreenIntegrationPlugin. Root CMake was not modified by this agent.

safety_and_state: Expected revisions distinguish missing files from existing empty files; external creation/edit/deletion conflicts preserve both disk bytes and drafts.
Malformed UTF-8 is reported per script variant without hiding the repository or blocking its other valid variant.
Windows reads verify the opened handle's final path and actual byte count; save temporary handles are checked under the main root. Cancellation is checked during reads and before commit.
Read results started before successful saves cannot overwrite newer baselines; edits made while saving remain unsaved drafts after the submitted version commits.
Guard reentry cannot start a second mutation; observer deletion paths use guarded/captured state.
Typing does not rebuild the unrelated worktree tree or reset code-editor undo history.
Controller destruction cancels its own requests only, never shared-service cancelAll.

display_refinement.behavior: Content-sized first columns each capped at 20% of the viewport; Status retains at least 40%; all column values have tooltips. 768px light/dark renders show complete Usage unknown and dirty/mounted status explanations.

verification.render_context: Hidden offscreen 768px fixture using actual source AppStyle/AppFonts, a temporary Git repository, populated PowerShell/Codex scripts and clean/dirty/mounted managed rows.
verification.authority: All Git mutations occurred in dedicated temporary fixture repositories. No user repository or active desktop app was changed by tests/renders.

remaining_limits: Revision comparison is optimistic against external noncooperating writers, not a filesystem-wide atomic compare-and-swap guarantee.
Windows handle containment is implemented; POSIX setup IO uses canonical-path checks and has not been runtime-tested here.
Drafts persist across view recreation within the application process, not across application restart.
Current historical usage remains unknown for cleanup. This slice does not claim multimount, cleanup or watcher parity.
